title: One queryable chain from source evidence to observed outcome
scope: Traversing, for any consequential action, the whole chain: source evidence, admitted facts, OpenBody observation, model version, patient-state snapshot, K-lines, model calls, AI objections, DG claims and human decisions, the authority grant, point-of-effect enforcement, the actual effects, the COSMIC transaction and the observed outcome — with commitments and references rather than duplicated PHI.
assumptions: The individual links exist in several repositories already; what is missing is the traversal that connects them and the commitments that anchor it.
Sensitive clinical content stays in its protected store; the provenance layer references rather than copies it.
